Web Opera | Act I

No. 9: CHATTERING CHORUS
"How beautifully blue the sky"

Girls. How beautifully blue the sky,
The glass is rising very high,
Continue fine I hope it may,
And yet it rained but yesterday.

(During MABEL'S solo the GIRLS continue their chatter pianissimo.)

Mabel.
Did ever maiden wake
From dream of homely duty,
To find her daylight break
With such exceeding beauty?		 Girls.
How beautifully blue the sky,
The glass is rising very high,
Continue fine I hope it may,
And yet it rained but yesterday.
Frederic.
Did ever pirate loathed
Forsake his hideous mission,
To find himself betrothed
To lady of position?		 Continue fine I hope it may,
And yet it rained but yesterday.
Mabel. Take heart, take any heart but ours...
Take heart, fair days will shine;
Chorus. Ah, ah! Fair days will shine,
Take heart, take mine!
